The '''Observatory Moon'''<ref name="Databank-Observatory Moon">{{Databank|observatory-moon|Observatory Moon}}</ref> was a [[moon]]<ref name="An Astrogation Problem" /> that [[orbit]]ed a [[gas giant]] [[planet]]<ref name="An Astrogation Problem AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> and was home to an [[Unidentified telescopic array|observatory]] operated by [[Kh'ymm]].<ref name="An Astrogation Problem" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> [[Jod Na Nawood]], whom Kh'ymm knew as Crimson Jack, brought a group of lost [[Youngling|children]] to the observatory moon in hope that Kh'ymm could guide them to their planet of [[At Attin]]. Kh'ymm assisted the children, but she also called in a pair of [[New Republic]] [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] to arrest Nawood, leading him and the children to escape with the supposed coordinates of the planet.<ref name="An Astrogation Problem" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Observatory Moon appeared in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]],"<ref name="An Astrogation Problem" /> the third episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 10]], [[2024]].<ref name="Release">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}}</ref>
